name: Fourcast
summary: Four-channel social desk: composer with live previews, drag calendar and per-channel stats
about: A complete social media desk for a small business posting to Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and Facebook. Write a post once and watch it in four channel previews, plan it on a drag-and-drop calendar, answer comments in one inbox and read stats per channel. It ships with sample data for a made-up Lahore bakery in a pastel block style, light and dark.
how: Open Compose, tick channels and type: each preview card updates as you write. Click a card or a tab to bring that channel to the front of the fanned stack.
The composer checks the rules: TikTok and YouTube need a video, and each channel has a character limit. Save a draft, schedule it or post now.
On Calendar, drag a post to another day, drag drafts from the tray onto a day, or drag a post back to the tray. Press Enter on a post for the same moves by keyboard.
Channels shows followers, daily views, a best-time heatmap and top posts per channel, with a 7D, 30D and 90D switch.
Inbox gathers comments and messages from all channels; new ones arrive live. Reply with quick answers or mark them done.
Posts has search, status chips, sorting, a stats drawer, boosts and retries. Settings connects channels, edits the brand and resets the demo.
